name: research-results-v1
authority: Deterministic structural authority for the Research Result V1 artifact. This contract defines the shape a research-results.json file MUST take. It does not judge truth, credibility, or semantic support — those remain Research judgment (Phase B+) and Mikko's human authority.

root.results: array of immutable result objects, required

artifact.immutability: A result entry, once written, is never mutated. New research appends a new result. A superseded result remains historical. Aggregate append never invalidates unrelated result bindings. Supersession is explicit via supersedes_result_id; superseded_by is derived, never written.

identity_rules.mindmap: canonical_idea_id is authority; discovery_claim_id is alias only
identity_rules.package_run_local: claim-<UUIDv4>, issued once; identity never derived from mutable claim text
identity_rules.revision_model: unchanged normalized proposition → same revision; wording/qualification/narrowing/temporal change → new revision+result; broadening → new revision + mandatory Research review; materially different proposition → new canonical claim ID; new evidence with unchanged proposition → same claim revision, new result revision
identity_rules.binding_rule: an old result can never authorize a different claim-text hash

qualification.rule: every constraint requires a stable constraint_id

rules: Google Doc title/owner is not proof of original authorship
unknown-origin evidence may lower semantic quality later but remains structurally valid
source_model.class_rule: classification, not credibility scoring; validator never infers OFFICIAL=true or SOCIAL=false

independence.grouping_rules: same original publication/dataset/press release/interview/event/syndicated chain → same group; ten articles repeating one press release → one group; different URLs or publishers do not automatically prove independence; unknown-origin containers for one claim grouped conservatively unless Research establishes otherwise
independence.support_count_rule: independent_support_count = count(unique independence_group) over valid evidence where stance == SUPPORTS; CONTRADICTS and CONTEXT_ONLY never increase it

temporal.unclassified_rule: UNCLASSIFIED may exist during incomplete Research but cannot authorize normal downstream QC use
temporal.current_fact: requires as_of + freshness policy (MAX_AGE_DAYS with integer days, or REVIEW_BY with ISO date); all supporting evidence must include retrieval date
temporal.historical_fact: requires effective/event date; source age alone must not stale it
temporal.evergreen: no arbitrary expiry; source/content/fingerprint change can still trigger revalidation
temporal.google_doc_rule: Google Doc modification date is never a substitute for event date

semantics.STALE: historically auditable, no longer valid for new downstream authorization
semantics.SUPERSEDED: valid historical Research result replaced by a later result
semantics.history_rule: history is never deleted merely because authority expired

result_digest.algorithm: SHA-256 over compact canonical UTF-8 JSON
result_digest.canonicalization: recursive object-key sort; deterministic sort of authoritative arrays (aliases, sources, evidence, constraints, provenance inputs); exact bytes hashed
includes: complete result excluding its digest field: identities, revisions, claim text/hash, temporal policy, judgments, rationales, qualifications, source records, evidence, stance, independence, provenance, lifecycle audit timestamps, supersession pointer
excludes: aggregate file ordering outside canonical normalization

rules: no mutation of old result objects
later result points backward via supersedes_result_id
one valid unsuperseded current head per claim
immutability_supersession.ambiguity_rule: two unsuperseded valid heads → ambiguity → fail closed; never silently choose latest timestamp

rules: human exception does not rewrite Research verdict
exception cannot repair corrupt evidence or missing provenance
exception cannot transform unsupported into supported
approval uses canonical artifact approval binding (scripts/agent-contract-validator.js verifyApprovalBinding)
human_exception.integration: Phase B; no production QC integration yet

validator_non_goals: whether two formulations mean the same thing
whether Mikko should take an editorial risk
